_note: Experimental, non-standard site discovery manifest. It is not an MCP server declaration and grants no transaction, mutation, safety-decision, or reliance authority. This is a static public read-only documentation surface; listed resources are GET-only.
name: M3-CRETE
description: Experimental open-source concrete/paste-printing motion-system design. Static documentation host with a machine-readable reference Bill of Materials; physical suitability requires independent review and validation.

resources.name: GetBOM
resources.description: Bill of Materials as JSON. Source of truth for parts, quantities, and supplier references. Current snapshot: 65 parts, 189 options, and 35 named suppliers; verify the live JSON because counts can change.

resources.name: GetPrinterSpecs
resources.description: Site index page with embedded CreativeWork JSON-LD for the open-hardware documentation project. Parse the application/ld+json script tag for structured data.

resources.name: ListVariants
resources.description: Model variants and their parameter overrides (M3-1, M3-2, M3-4) as a JavaScript module. The MODEL_VARIANTS export contains build volume and quantity overrides.

related.cemforge.ai: Early-stage materials evidence and decision-support service; outputs require physical validation and qualified review
related.open3dcp.org: Public draft schema for recording 3D-concrete-printing data; it does not supply a dataset
